issue.title: Weak kitchen tap

intake.title: Weak kitchen tap
intake.description: The kitchen faucet has weak flow. Other taps are normal. I do not know the model.

step.why: Buildup can restrict flow, but it does not prove which part needs attention.
step.title: What can you see at the end of the tap?
step.detail: Look without removing anything. Do you see mineral buildup, debris or an uneven spray?

source.label: Moen: faucet aerators
source.quote: A: Over time, aerators can accumulate debris and mineral deposits, which can restrict water pressure or distort the spray pattern.

adaptive.explanation: The kitchen tap has weak flow. The aerator, which is the part at the end of the tap, can get clogged with debris or mineral buildup, causing low flow. Checking the aerator is a good first step to see if this is the problem.
